about: Gate G3's ten stretches (plan: 'G2 again on ten stretches spread over 1997 to 2017'). Each is a moment the page itself offers (the landing moments of settings.html and the harness's moments.mjs), so it is known to hold pictures, at the speed the page plays it. g3_stretches.mjs runs the harness session S1 (default play, both cameras) on each with --moment and --speed, then the cost model on all ten. The cruise years 1997 to 1999 have no page moment; Jupiter (2000-12) is the earliest stretch. Before the run, the rig's /frames/slices.json must cover every stretch (the runner checks and names any it does not).
